post_add_fixup: bun add writes an exact version and discards the caret range. Restore "^{version}" in package.json, then re-run `bun install`. Verify with `git diff frontend/package.json` that nothing moved dep/devDep sections.

cooldown.note: A refused install is the policy working. Never add a minimumReleaseAgeExcludes entry to get around it. Overrides bypass this check entirely -- run check_cooldown.py for every pin.

transitive_pin.note: Ship overrides as their own PR, never folded into a version-bump PR.

baseline_tools_note: These produce the build/lint counts compare_baseline.py diffs. Bumping one moves its own yardstick: an unchanged count is no longer evidence -- read the message diff.
